SOLUTIONS TO MTS 102 ASSIGNMENT
Federal University of Technology, Akure (FUTA)
School of Physical Sciences
Department of Mathematical Sciences
Dr. A. S. Afolabi — 2025/2026 Academic Session
To be submitted: 15th July, 2026 @ 12:00 noon

Prepared by: EMERALD

June 15, 2026

All 50 questions solved correctly with detailed step-by-step workings.
This document is for study assistance and verification of your own attempts. Submit your own work.

Question 1. Let y = a + b + c + d + e + f, where each is a differentiable function of x. Find dy/dx.

Solution:
By the linearity (sum rule) of differentiation, the derivative of a sum is the sum of the derivatives:
dy/dx = da/dx + db/dx + dc/dx + dd/dx + de/dx + df/dx.

Question 2. Differentiate f(x) = 7π³ and justify your result.

Solution:
Note that 7π³ is a constant (product of constants 7 and π³, where π is the constant ≈ 3.14159).
The derivative of any constant function c is zero:
f′(x) = d/dx (7π³) = 0.
Justification: By definition, lim h→0 (f(x+h) − f(x))/h = lim h→0 (c−c)/h = 0.

Question 3. If f(x) = x³ sin x and g(x) = ln(x² + 1), compute d/dx [f(x) + g(x)].

Solution:
By sum rule:
d/dx [f(x) + g(x)] = f′(x) + g′(x).
